about: Fixed graphs with their expected reach and exclusive sets, written down once. scripts/lib/retire-property.js checks them against the real codemap.reach and features.retirement, and generates Model/Examples.lean, where Lean checks the same numbers against the model. A drift between model and code makes one side fail. Files are numbers; a number listed in docs is a document.

examples.name: docEndsChain
examples.note: A document reached from another file ends the chain; the same document as an anchor is walked.

examples.name: sharedHelperWithCycle
examples.note: Two features share a helper that sits on a cycle; only the entry files are exclusive.

examples.name: anchorDocAlsoReached
examples.note: File 0 is a document: feature A anchors it and walks on to 6, feature C only reaches it and stops, so 6 is exclusive to A.

examples.name: sharedAnchorNoEdges
examples.note: No edges: a feature reaches exactly its anchors, and an anchor two features share is not exclusive.
